remarks: Spacious 4-bedroom unit with the potential for a 5th bedroom, plus an additional office/living space. This newly renovated unit is in a prime location, just 2 minutes from I-95, making it easy to avoid local traffic. The eat-in kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances, including a dishwasher, gas range, and range hood. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry.  Located a short drive from the Metro-North station, ShopRite, Stamford parks, sports amenities like Chelsea Piers, Terry Conners Rink, and Cove Island beach, and close to downtown, shopping malls, restaurants, fitness centers, and public recreation.  Heat is powered by gas, and rent includes water, sewer, and one assigned parking spot. The tenant is responsible for internet, cable, electricity, gas, heat, cooking gas, and hot water.  Don't miss out-come see it before it's gone!
